accessBasis.gate: Onboarding route /connect-tally; no in-app entry point outside onboarding (only waiting_for_companies_screen pushes onward to /select-companies).

behaviourReviewed: The screen watches for an active loader session and advances to /waiting-for-companies by itself; the manual check button only re-reads the same session.
Manual check with no session shows the snackbar 'Loader not yet connected. Please install and run the Windows client.'
Waiting screen auto-advances to /select-companies when companies arrive and offers a 5-item Connection Troubleshooting dialog.
Select Companies persists the chosen tally_companies and moves to /sync-progress.
Sync progress ends on Ready to Go! with a Go to Home button.
The four numbered instruction steps are Download Windows Client / Install on Your PC / Link Your Account / Select Companies.
inventoryDeviations: The inventory names only lib/screens/connect_tally_screen.dart, but the connect procedure genuinely spans waiting_for_companies_screen.dart, select_companies_screen.dart and sync_progress_screen.dart. Those three were read and quoted from; topics.json sourceFiles was left untouched (another agent owns it).
deliberatelyOmitted: The exact Tally menu path for enabling the XML port: it differs by Tally version and is not stated anywhere in the app. The guide says what has to be true and who to ask.
Any claim that a wrongly-selected company can be un-selected from the phone; no such screen exists outside onboarding, so the guide routes to support.

The 'I've installed the loader' label is stored in Dart with an escaped apostrophe, so only the substring 'installed the loader' is declared and the body words it as a description rather than a caption.
